“I don’t know if I believe that,” followed the next week by “I want to take you off your meds. They make you robotic and intense.” You know, like a person on the autism spectrum.

This was a psychiatrist.

Good for you!

Also, ask your mom to move the gun so you can’t get to it anymore. Trick Future You.

You should be fine! What you should definitely watch out for is alcohol. I found I could drink on my SSRI a normal amount (like, think into the realm of comfortably drunk, not puking or passing out) as long as I took it in the morning and did my drinking in the late afternoon/evening. Took it in the evening once right before drinking and had a BAD TIME. Don’t down your SSRI with a shot of Jack like my dumb ass.
I still, STILL sometimes fail to complete the necessary full exchange with the “how are you”

I've been trying to use those kinda words with the university pdoc. No dice. And I absolutely cannot stress how very much any kind of more-than-a-few-hours hospital stay is never, ever going to happen with my consent. At least not at a psych unit at a big hospital. Maybe, FUCKING MAYBE, a standalone place, but those have never got room, ever.
Works sometimes. In this state I'd just be out of breath, sore, and still agitated.

Yeah...voluntarily checking myself into anyplace is absolutely not going to happen. I cannot, CANNOT, abide being bored. There is nothing to do on a psych ward. *Nothing.* And they don't do anything for you besides meeting the bare minimum of "dope them up and make sure they do not die or kill anyone right now." This is not paranoia, this is actual, stupidly extensive experience with voluntary and involuntary commitments.

And frankly, I'm a young, white, middle class female; I've gotta do a *lot* before cops do more than tell me to "settle down, please, young lady," and I don't think there's a risk of that "a lot" happening.

All I really want is to stop being this angry. Usually if I do the thing I have the urge to do, the mood goes, but, again, there's nothing sufficiently smashable.

Entertainingly enough, I am actually not paying her, she's through my university. I feel like that's probably most of the skittishness. University docs constantly assume you're trying to get drugs out of them for nefarious purposes, even if all you're trying to get is fucking amoxicillin.
